frank.finding: Minimal loop dynamics/control must preserve typed state, budgets, halt/intervention/rollback and external authority separation.

clayresearch.finding: BASE gate prioritizes implementation over semantic redesign; loop-of-loops remains an OPEN shared research hypothesis.

claygraph.finding: Loop topology/readouts may project as epoch-bound derived state; activation/topology cannot mint truth or effect authority.

unifieddb.finding: Loop observations/interventions/receipts fit revisioned semantic state and execution receipts without requiring physical monolithic storage.

gwt.finding: Loop continuation/admission may be tested as routing, but selection/use/outcome/re-entry remain distinct.

hyperposition.finding: REOPEN_ALTERNATIVE can remain a typed control decision; preserved alternatives do not require a new ClayCode core primitive in the tested case.

emergenz.finding: Dynamics classification is observability/control state, not emergence evidence.

harness.finding: H1/H2 remain blocked by BASE; current local proxy is not Harness or Ubuntu-target evidence.

claycode.finding: Existing records + cycle + typed dialect operation are sufficient for the tested minimal loop controller; no core semantic change justified.
